source.name: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates Drafthouse
source.rightsEvidence: The pinned repository template is under MIT. Its retained Drafthouse credits identify each bundled photo as CC0/Public Domain. Both notices are included in this dossier.

provenance.capture: Pinned template rendered locally at 1440px and 390px content widths. Lazy images were loaded before capture; a closed off-canvas drawer was hidden only for the mobile capture because it otherwise expanded the page canvas. Visible page content and source markup were unchanged.
provenance.attribution: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates, MIT. Per-template photography credits retained; the source footer remains visible in both screenshots.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A calm architecture studio fieldbook. A compact paper-toned navigation row sits above a full-width, image-led featured project; the title and small project metadata are anchored over the lower image edge. A narrow practice statement transitions into a dated project index, a ruled principles/process ledger, capabilities, awards, people, and a structured enquiry form. The source uses archival photographs and demo locations, awards, people, metrics, and project records, none of which are client facts.

heroGeometry.alignment: full-width image, with project name and compact facts anchored near its lower edge
heroGeometry.viewport: top navigation and enough of the project image/title to establish the practice before scrolling

navigationGeometry.mobile: wordmark and one enquiry action remain visible; anchors collapse into a compact menu

typography.scale: medium display statements, small uppercase metadata labels, concise body copy

palette.contrastIntent: low-chroma architectural calm while preserving readable body and action contrast

imageTreatment.crop: wide featured project with repeated varied project crops
imageTreatment.focalPoint: building/site geometry remains legible and text sits in a quiet lower image zone

servicePresentation.pattern: compact capability blocks after a project and principles archive
servicePresentation.interaction: anchor navigation and understated project links

ctaPlacement.primary: project enquiry in navigation and structured closing form
ctaPlacement.early: compact enquiry link near the featured project opening

motion.primitive: active section indication while reading project chapters
motion.reducedMotion: static image chapters and direct anchor navigation

rules: preserve featured image before project metadata
stack enquiry fields in reading order

prohibitedPatterns: copied studio name, project copy, people, portraits or awards
invented project area, stage, location, client or planning outcome
historical or stock portrait presented as current staff
portfolio image represented as client work without proof

requiredSignatureElements.description: full-width project image with restrained title and verified metadata
portfolio presented as documented project records
ruled process/principles list rather than repeated cards
enquiry that begins with project context

acceptanceChecks: portfolio imagery is client-approved and truthfully labeled
service scope and service areas are factual
people and awards appear only when confirmed
the project index is visually distinct from generic cards
the enquiry path asks only useful briefing questions
mobile project metadata remains readable beside its image

review.scope: pinned MIT template, per-image CC0/Public Domain evidence, full-page desktop/mobile captures, and transferable architecture mechanics
